cases.name: valid direct, nested and committed records
unknown fingerprints (legacy-style NULLs) are accepted
sql: UPDATE material_split_lineage SET source_content_sha256 = NULL WHERE material_id = 'A'

cases.name: a pending and a cancelled record are accepted
equivalent table formatting is accepted
sql: UPDATE sqlite_master SET sql = replace(sql, '    ', ' ') WHERE name = 'material_split_lineage'

cases.name: an extra lineage column is refused
sql: ALTER TABLE material_split_lineage ADD COLUMN extra TEXT

cases.name: a missing operation log is refused
a removed self-root CHECK is refused
sql: UPDATE sqlite_master SET sql = replace(sql, 'CHECK (material_id != root_material_id),', '') WHERE name = 'material_split_lineage'

cases.name: a root reference that cascades deletion is refused
sql: UPDATE sqlite_master SET sql = replace(sql, 'root_material_id       TEXT REFERENCES study_materials(id) ON DELETE SET NULL', 'root_material_id       TEXT REFERENCES study_materials(id) ON DELETE CASCADE') WHERE name = 'material_split_lineage'

cases.name: a missing lineage index is refused
a missing operation status index is refused
a malformed original fingerprint is refused
